title: Interactive TUI: two-pane browser, review queue, multi-project
description:
Epic: a ratatui TUI for pebbles. Three pillars:
1. Two-pane browser: left = foldable tree of epics with child pebbles (reuses list --tree data + epic progress counts); right = detail pane for the highlighted issue (show output, relationships, spec refs). Design baseline: 94223b04.
2. Review-queue mode: one-key approve/close over the proposed queue, built on bulk-operation primitives (0c580f95).
3. Multi-project layer: projects above epics — scan ~/repos for .pebbles (unless config lists other dirs), sorted by pebbles index mtime, most recent first (design c302f8f4).
TUI features must land with SPEC r[tui-*] rules and tests, per the repo's spec+design approach.
